# MidHandle <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MidHandle:Void image:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image. |

## Description

Puts the handle of an image in its middle. Images drawn at a position then appear centered on it, and rotate and scale around their middle.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(40, 40)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
Color 255, 160, 0
Rect 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
MidHandle img
Cls
DrawImage img, MouseX(), MouseY()
Print ImageXHandle(img) + ", " + ImageYHandle(img)
Flip
WaitKey
```
